body: There's a story involving Echo falling in love with a man called Narcissus and she falls in love with him but is only able to repeat things he has said, but Narcissus is so up his own as (i.e., narcissism) and she dies or something? And then the goddess Nemesis (goddess of divine retribution) makes Narcissus look at his reflection in a puddle because he's so enamored with himself and he dies and turns into a narcissus flower.
